verdict.rationale: The only product-native evidence is a guided fine-tuning flow on fireworks.ai: "Describe the task, review the plan and cost, approve the run, and get a trained model." This reads as delegating a task to an in-product agent, but it is a single marketing line limited to training. Tool calling, the Nexus CLI and the API playground are developer building blocks or adjacent features, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: an explicitly documented built-in AI assistant, coverage beyond fine-tuning, docs on how delegation and approval work, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
